DML.SELECT: SELECT transit_id as "id", transit_type_id as "transitTypeId", transit_type_param_id as "transitTypeParamId", value as "value", visible as "visible", created_at as "createdAt", updated_at as "updatedAt" FROM rt.transit_values
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO rt.transit_values ( transit_id, transit_type_id, transit_type_param_id, value, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ( :id, :transitTypeId, :transitTypeParamId, :value, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.DELETE: DELETE FROM rt.transit_values WHERE transit_id = :id AND transit_type_id = :transitTypeId AND transit_type_param_id = :transitTypeParamId
